title: Know WHY. Know HOW. Then WHAT?
coreMove: A product is proof only after WHY names the promise and HOW names the conduct; otherwise WHAT can look useful while bringing nothing clear back.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a useful offer with no proof
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: spot the early signal before proof returns

exampleSpecs.stakes: a broad claim that costs proof
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: state the standard and pay the cost

exampleSpecs.stakes: an impressive WHAT that bends meaning
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: catch the miss after the demand is already set
ask what stayed broken at the return
